desc: Prove CJ's Bluetooth acceptance test: an OBEX object-push file transfer between the M1 host (controller F8:4D:89:6C:92:CB) and the M4, either direction. Runs on the headless WiFi/BT RAM root, so it is INDEPENDENT of the dirty-SD gate (215/216) and mutates no storage. v4 ARTIFACT (v3 and earlier are withdrawn): Image 43e1a7d4 (Linux 7.1.3-g4f2429104009; pcie-apple, macsmc, brcmfmac, hci_bcm4377 builtin), DTB t6040-j614s-dcuart-wifi-cpufreq 7fea8942, initramfs initramfs-alpine-wifi-obex.v4build1 b04ccc1e (two clean byte-identical builds; t6040-image-preflight.sh OK). maxcpus=1. PROCEDURE, driven over ttydc0 -- NOT ssh: host-side $HOME/wpa.conf currently holds an un-run wpa_passphrase command instead of a network={} block, so WiFi does not auto-associate and sshd comes up with no address. Do not depend on ssh until CJ supplies a real wpa.conf. Steps: tethered chainload; confirm hci0; run 't6040-bt-obex receive'; require OBEXD_FLAGS_OK (bus-name presence alone is NOT sufficient -- a bus-activated obexd owns the name but rejects pushes), org.bluez.obex PRESENT, adapter discoverable/pairable. DIRECTION: M1->M4 is preferred and needs no macOS system-settings change (Bluetooth File Exchange sends outbound). M4->M1 additionally needs Bluetooth Sharing enabled on the Mac, which is CJ's to enable, not an agent's. PASS = a file arrives with a matching SHA-256 in either direction. SAFETY, corrected: no storage mutation; the helper writes no SMC key, SPMI register, PMU, charger, NVRAM, or firmware, and only rfkill-unblocks the BT soft-block. NOTE the earlier blanket claim 'no SMC/SPMI/PMU/NVRAM write' was wrong about the BOOT, not the helper: the standard pinned DTB enables spmi@509014000 + pmic@e and macsmc-reboot is builtin, so macsmc_reboot_probe() writes boot_stage=KERNEL_STARTED and resets panic/boot-error counters via PMU nvmem over SPMI on EVERY boot of every Wallace image. apple,smc-reboot is on the AGENTS.md permitted list and this is pre-existing standard behaviour, not a property of this artifact. pwren-gpios use only the approved gP13 (0x13) and gP19 (0x19). STOP CONDITIONS: SError, DART/IOMMU fault, firmware panic, unexpected reset, console loss before the T6040_OBEX_* marker, or any access outside this scope. FIXTURE: internal BCM4388 only; no external BT device attached; DebugUSB on left-back/HPM0. RECOVERY: sanctioned warm reboot; RAM root, so /var/lib/bluetooth is tmpfs and pairing keys do not survive -- nothing persists. OPEN: needs an independent re-review of the v4 artifact; the v3 review (evidence linked) returned FAIL on five items, all now fixed: obexd's invalid --no-input option (fatal; obexd does not ignore unknown GOptions), obexd stderr discarded, the bus-activation silent-rejection hazard, the missing Norwegian keymap, and this record's missing hashes/stop conditions/fixture/recovery. BLOCKED 2026-08-04 (fable): no tethered chainload is possible until CJ re-enrolls the always-proxy rollback object (rollback-m1n1-1394c345.bin) from 1TR. The currently enrolled m1n1 t6040-e11-tag2 vectors straight into Linux, which consumes the proxy, so recovery boots cannot produce a uartproxy. Artifact is built, hash-pinned and reviewed; only the enrollment gates it. See evidence/2026-08-04-t6040-rig-blocked-enrolled-object-has-no-proxy.md.
